title: Named blueprint with an optional blueprint input supplied

chat.content: Set up the notify-topic blueprint for me. Owner NetID mjs42, and subscribe mjs42@cornell.edu to the topic so I get the emails.

gold_answer_sketch: Calls deployment_create with dry_run=true, passing notification_email through the parameters map under the manifest's own key name. Summarizes the returned plan: the registration PR, the stack aidlc-main-notify-topic, and the deployment shell. Notes that notify-topic is a singleton so the deployment name is the blueprint name. Mentions the real-world consequence the blueprint documents, that SNS sends a confirmation link the subscriber must click before delivery starts, and that none of this happens until the PR is merged by a human.
judge_focus: Whether the optional blueprint input is carried in the parameters dict under the manifest key notification_email rather than dropped, renamed, or promoted to a top-level argument.
notes: Probes parameter plumbing against the real C1 manifest. A common failure is inventing an argument like email= or silently discarding the address because the tool signature does not name it.
